# Clay Consulting

Clay Consulting is a UK marketing and business strategy consultancy helping therapists, counsellors and therapy organisations grow their private practice.

## Who this is for

Qualified therapists, counsellors, and therapy organisations in the UK who want to grow a private practice: more of the right clients, a stronger website and directory presence, and a business that runs well behind the scenes.

## What Clay offers

- **A free 15-minute call** — a short conversation to work out whether Clay can help, and which option makes sense. No cost.
- **A strategy session** (£120, one hour) — a clear objective and the actions to move towards it, based on a conversation about where the practice is now and where it needs to go.
- **A Practice Health Check** (scoped and agreed per engagement, no fixed price) — a full audit of a practice's website, search visibility, directory listings, Google Business Profile and competitors, delivered as a written report with prioritised recommendations.

Clay is run personally by George Holloway, who is currently training as a psychotherapist at CCPE, alongside a commercial marketing and strategy background including a role as Senior Growth Manager at Amazon.
